# Native hook fixture provenance

`codex-live-captured-success.json` and `codex-live-captured-failure.json` are newline-terminated test copies of bounded raw stdin captures from the same production `workbench context hook --harness codex` handler invoked through a temporary hook wrapper during one authenticated Codex smoke run on 2026-09-09. The wrapper wrote each stdin byte stream to a private temporary file while piping the unchanged stream to the handler, so handler stdout semantics were preserved. The exact source bytes remain at `/tmp/wctx-capture-codex.p9fgyk73/hook-stdin/stdin.7sO4Qt.json` (success, 588 bytes, sha256 `9f4620d51021c2e93388b0fa2b3bc96a453ac2bd41fd60a4e56f8a08d2edca2f`) and `/tmp/wctx-capture-codex.p9fgyk73/hook-stdin/stdin.W7qKMX.json` (failure, 625 bytes, sha256 `f8c66427d1512fee0aaf7783b2461ad04e4d412a7417767df90a24f64908ea71`); their private credential copy was removed after the run. Each committed Codex fixture adds one trailing LF for repository text-fixture portability: success is 589 bytes, sha256 `e22e5b5f4613db80ddbba56beac7bc291abca293bcda29eb242480e47d28baf3`; failure is 626 bytes, sha256 `c57332f835dc8f5324a9de52ddb624760fc94d5feef50c142fd1927f525fc0c3`.

`claude-controlled-native-post-tool-batch-success.json` and `claude-controlled-native-post-tool-batch-failure.json` are newline-terminated test copies of exact native Claude `PostToolBatch` stdin captured through the same production handler with the deterministic loopback endpoint in `/tmp/workbench-context-claude-five-hooks.py`. They are controlled-endpoint/native-host evidence, not actual-model evidence. Exact source bytes remain at `/tmp/workbench-context-claude-five-hooks.e7euscox/success/evidence/hook-stdin/stdin.A6VKCl.json` (730 bytes, sha256 `d21eb2fe2e91a4d907c2b7d34a10e23017ed7f7b17b2f85e30b58fe547229abe`) and `/tmp/workbench-context-claude-five-hooks.e7euscox/failure/evidence/hook-stdin/stdin.xRbedA.json` (801 bytes, sha256 `653634216afa30757dcb6c03b154bf088a909b6d6da338052a7c467df5641ef8`).

The remaining fixtures in this directory are deliberately constructed adversarial envelopes. They are not claims about provider wire format and are used to exercise the normalization contract. The actual-model Claude attempt stopped before a tool call because the isolated OAuth copy was expired; the controlled loopback run did successfully capture native Claude shapes above. Fixture copies are newline-normalized; the exact Codex source hashes are recorded above, and the Claude fixture hashes are `d21eb2fe2e91a4d907c2b7d34a10e23017ed7f7b17b2f85e30b58fe547229abe` and `653634216afa30757dcb6c03b154bf088a909b6d6da338052a7c467df5641ef8`.
